question: What is the geometric mean of the monthly outlays (in nominal dollars) of the US judiciary from January 1984 to March 1987? Report the number in millions rounded to the nearest thousandth.
raw_response:
39 monthly values (Jan 1984 – Mar 1987), all read from Table FFO-3 "Budget Outlays by Agency", The judiciary column, in millions of dollars across four bulletin issues (1985_03, 1986_03, 1987_03, 1987_12).

Geometric mean = 81.335 million.

<FINAL_ANSWER>81.335</FINAL_ANSWER>
